    AI Overview
    On Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026,
    many major retailers and restaurants will remain open, though often with reduced hours. Key open stores include Walmart, CVS, Walgreens, Trader Joe's, Rite Aid, and Whole Foods. Most major retail chains like Target, Costco, and Publix will be closed. 
    Open Retail and Grocery Stores 
    • Walmart: Open regular hours.
    • CVS & Walgreens: Open regular hours; some pharmacy locations may be closed or have reduced hours.
    • Trader Joe's: Open.
    • Whole Foods Market: Open, often closing early at 6 p.m. or 8 p.m..
    • Dollar General & Family Dollar: Open.
    • Home Depot & IKEA: Open.
    • Petco & PetSmart: Open. 
    Closed Retailers 
    • Target, Costco, Sam’s Club.
    • Aldi, Publix, H-E-B.
    • Kohl’s, Best Buy, Dick's Sporting Goods, Macy's. 
    Open Restaurants
    Many fast-food and chain restaurants will be open, including: 
    • Starbucks, Dunkin', McDonald's, Burger King, Wendy's, Taco Bell.
    • Cracker Barrel, IHOP, Golden Corral.
    • Note: Many local, independent restaurants may be closed, so it is best to call ahead. 
    Services 
    • Post Offices (USPS): Closed.
    • UPS: Closed.
    • FedEx: Open. 
    Always check with your local store or restaurant before visiting, as hours can vary by location.
